assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D animation sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the existing green zombie rider sheet to REDRAW; image 2 is only the game's style and scale reference. Redraw the zombie poses into exactly FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of twelve equal square cells, ideally1536x1152, with generous transparent gutters. The SAME approved green zombie, purple spiky hair, huge orange eyes, ragged purple shirt, brown shorts, bare feet, thick dark ink contours and detailed gothic cartoon shading. CRITICAL ANATOMY: a genuine side view riding STRADDLE on a narrow jet-ski saddle, facing RIGHT. The pelvis bears weight on the saddle; the near thigh extends forward, knee bends about ninety degrees and ONE near calf/foot drops below the seat. The FAR leg is on the opposite side of the jet-ski and MUST BE ENTIRELY HIDDEN, not drawn beside the near leg. Do not draw two feet or two parallel shins on the visible side. No boat, saddle, handlebar, scenery or floor is drawn; just the complete rider with head, torso, arms and ONE visible bent leg. Row1 FOUR DIFFERENT pilot cels: both arms extending forward to a low handlebar, braced seated hips, subtle readable recoil/lean and hair movement; hips aligned. Row2 FOUR DIFFERENT passenger cels: seated astride behind pilot, hands gripping forward at waist level, leaning back/forward from spray. Row3 FOUR DIFFERENT duck cels: deep forward crouch while seated astride, face near hands, compressed torso then recovering, NOT standing. All heads and faces fully opaque and intact, green skin without transparency holes, full toes and fingers, no ghosted limbs, no duplicate outlines, no highlights floating outside silhouette. Consistent character proportions and hip height, safe margins, no cell overlap. True transparent background, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no watermark. Keep the polished existing game style; do not make a realistic illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated pursuit-flood sprite atlas for the provided gothic cartoon zombie game. Image1 is the old flood sheet to REPLACE; image2 is the game's actual art STYLE reference only. Completely redesign the flood to be SCARY, grotesque and alive, while matching the game: deep teal-black sewer water, purple ink shadows, dark burgundy bloody streaks, pale bone/mint foam, bold black outlines and clean richly shaded cartoon volumes. Not photoreal, not neon green slime. Exactly FOUR columns FOUR rows, sixteen sequential animation cels of ONE consistent rushing monster-wave moving RIGHT. Use a portrait atlas ideally1280x1792, sixteen320x448 cells, no visible grid. Each cel contains a TALL relatively NARROW wall of surging water, not a flat triangular hill, with the front edge towering over the riders. An ominous skull-like screaming face is formed by the FOAM and dark hollow water near its curling front; a few clawlike skeletal foam hands and small bone debris emerge from the turbulent surface, and dark red blood-like veins twist inside the water. A frightening gothic cartoon monster made of water, no detached human bodies. The sixteen frames show a continuous developed motion: swelling crest, jaws opening, clawed foam reaching forward, crest breaking into detailed spray, curling back, reforming and smoothly returning to the initial mass. Substantial fluid motion through every frame, not sixteen almost identical static poses, no rapid flickering size changes. Consistent contact baseline and volume, preserve tall column silhouette, complete curling top visible with safety margins, organic transparent left edges and spray, no rigid opaque rectangle. No tiny horizontal wave or green foam paste. True TRANSPARENT alpha around each cel, full subject fits each cell without spilling into neighbors. No scene, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Intended to draw around450gamepixels tall and240wide at the LEFT of the gameplay, clearly visible pursuing the boats.

Input1 is ONLY a costume/posture inspiration reference from Resident Evil 4; input2 defines the actual game's gothic cartoon style and large expressive heads; input3 is ONLY the game's painted jet-ski craft style. Do not reproduce a screenshot. Create exactly FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, twelve equal cells, preferably2048x1152, each cell512x384. Every cell shows a COMPLETE jet-ski side view facing RIGHT with properly seated riders astride their narrow saddles. Row1: four genuinely different driving/leaning/recoil/look-back animation poses of the SAME original adult young AGENT alone on a dark steel-blue jet-ski. Side-parted sandy blond hair, black tactical short-sleeve shirt, dark gray trousers, fingerless gloves and boots, serious but comically worried large expressive eyes, original chibi face. Row2: four different driving/leaning/fear/look-back poses of the SAME original adult young WOMAN alone on the same type of steel-blue jet-ski: blonde bob, orange turtleneck sweater, burgundy scarf, muted green plaid skirt over opaque dark leggings and practical brown boots, frightened but spirited expressive face. Row3: four different tandem driving/leaning/look-back/recoil poses of BOTH characters together on ONE two-seat jet-ski: man pilots in front, woman sits astride directly behind and grips his waist; exactly TWO humans, no extra rider. Match the scale and hull in ALL rows and frames, full bow and stern always visible, waterline baseline common; hull mostly horizontal with subtle pose changes. Important anatomy: each person's far leg is on the opposite side hidden BEHIND the boat. Only ONE near shin/foot per rider is visible and rests correctly in the side footwell, never both shins side by side like a bench. The hull overlaps the rider's far limbs. The hips visibly rest on saddles, hands actually meet low handlebars/waist, no floating riders. Bold dark ink outlines, detailed shaded cartoon volumes, huge character heads, purple shadows, cold teal metal and restrained brass highlights; match the supplied game screenshot, no realistic 3D people. Distinct heads and poses, fully opaque faces, no missing hands, no extra legs. True TRANSPARENT alpha, generous transparent margins per cell; no scenery, no water rectangle, no wake attached to adjacent cells, no text, no logo, no watermark, no grid.
